subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-09-11
html:
Weekly Pulse — Sept 11, 2026

~10 weeks since kickoff (2026-07-04). Shipped since last pulse-style session (2026-09-10): that session's own fresh SE Ranking pull found no new human-independent content gap (the emerging MCP-cluster demand — meta/shopify/hubspot/mailchimp MCP terms — is all gated behind still-overdue catalog.ts connectors), so it shipped site-wide security headers (README.md P1 #14) instead: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and Strict-Transport-Security, live-verified via curl. This pulse re-confirms the SE Ranking connector is authenticated for a 2nd consecutive session and pulls fresh data rather than reporting stale figures.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending — GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing, but this sandbox still has no outbound GA4 API access. Waiting on the scheduled data Action (12-week-strategy.md Week 8) to backfill this row.

Ranking movement

Fresh live pull this session (PROJECT_getSummary + PROJECT_getPositionHistory, 2026-09-04→2026-09-11, daily, site_id 12704162): average position flat at 100 (not-ranked floor) every single day, total_up: 0, total_down: 0. All 22 tracked keywords remain unranked, unchanged since tracking began 2026-07-04.

0 of 22 tracked keywords hold a measurable position for the 10th straight week. domain_trust steady at 5 (ticked 4→5 on 2026-09-01, unchanged since). index_google: "1" continues to confirm Google is indexing the domain despite zero ranked terms — an indexation-without-rankings pattern consistent with a brand-new DA-0 domain still in its ramp window.

Traffic vs last week

Pending — GSC/GA4 session-level traffic is unreachable from this sandbox (no outbound HTTP to Google's consumer APIs). As a directional proxy: DATA_getBacklinksSummary (domain mode) shows 3 backlinks / 2 referring domains, unchanged since the 2026-09-10 pull (which was itself the first backlink movement in 6+ weeks, up from 2/1). All 3 backlinks point at the homepage from 1 page across 2 domains (futurlabs.dev + one other) — incidental, not a shipped off-page listing. AI search visibility (DATA_getAiSearchOverview, US, all engines): brand presence n/a, link presence 0, AI-opportunity traffic 0 — no change, no prior-period baseline yet to compare against.

Anything broken?

No. Checked GitHub Actions directly: the last 2 SEO Report Email runs (2026-09-07, 2026-09-10) both completed success, one report + one archive-commit each, no duplicate-fire like the 2026-09-03 incident. All-time: 34 of 35 SEO Report Email runs green (the one historical duplicate-run failure already logged, nothing new). catalog.ts re-checked directly against source: all 5 previously-flagged connectors remain coming_soon and overdue — shopify (Apr 2026 eta, 5+ months overdue, still the single most-overdue entry), meta_ads/linkedin_ads/meta_pages (May 2026, 4+ months overdue), tiktok_ads/stripe (June 2026, 3+ months overdue), hubspot/mailerlite (July 2026, 2+ months overdue), mailchimp (August 2026, now past its own ETA month). None have flipped to live/beta. Off-page Phase 1 still 0 of 6 listings; GSC sitemap submission still open since kickoff (2026-07-04) — both unchanged, both need a human with a browser.

Reading the week

The SE Ranking connector held its authentication for a 2nd straight session — worth watching whether that continues, since it lapsed for 3 consecutive sessions as recently as early September. With that connector live, this pulse ran on fresh data end to end rather than stale figures for the first time in three pulses. The numbers themselves haven't moved: 0 of 22 keywords ranked, backlinks flat at 3/2 since the incidental bump on 09-10, and AI search visibility still at zero. That's expected at week 10 of a 6–12 month organic ramp on a DA-0 domain, not a regression. The real story is unchanged from the last several pulses: on-page and technical work (this week: security headers; recent weeks: schema fixes, on-page retargets, comparison content) keeps shipping cleanly with zero regressions, but every lever that could actually move rankings or backlinks — off-page listings, GSC submission, the 5 overdue catalog.ts connectors — is human-gated and still open. Nothing in this week's fresh pull changes that picture or surfaces a new content opportunity worth an unscheduled session.
